text: 从中国出口信用保险公司获悉，今年前8个月，中国信保扩大出口信用保险覆盖面，承保金额8541.8亿美元，同比增长12.6%；服务客户25.1万家，同比增长5.2%。（新华社）
text_en: Learned from the China Export & Credit Insurance Corporation that in the first eight months of this year, Sinosure expanded the coverage of export credit insurance, with an insured amount of 854.18 billion USD, up 12.6% year-on-year; it served 251,000 clients, up 5.2% year-on-year. (Xinhua News Agency)
